headlineOfDay: Jensen Huang's return to Nvidia, backed by Trump, sparked Wall Street's best day in over a year and a global tech rally.

markets.summary: US stocks had their best day in more than a year on Monday after Nvidia's board reinstated Jensen Huang as chief executive, with the Nasdaq up 6.5% and the S&P 500 up 4.7%. Nvidia added almost $1tn in value, Asian markets followed higher overnight, while consumer stocks lagged and Brent crude slipped to near three-month lows.

stories.headline: Huang's return powers best US trading day in over a year
stories.summary: Nvidia posted the biggest one-day gain in stock-market history after reinstating Jensen Huang, lifting chipmakers, Oracle and CoreWeave, and nearly wiping out products betting against the stock. Strategists say the move could put a floor under the recent AI sell-off, and Asian and emerging-market stocks rallied in its wake.
